issue.title: Migrate navigation from React Navigation stack to Expo Router
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Fluent Mobile currently uses a hand-wired `@react-navigation/stack` navigator (`AppNavigator`) with screen components under `src/app/screens/` and `src/app/tabs/`. We want to move the app’s navigation layer to **Expo Router** so routing, layouts, and deep links follow Expo’s file-based model instead of maintaining a custom stack setup.

This came up while reviewing [#266](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/266) (settings slide-out panel): that PR correctly ships a custom Modal + Animated + gesture drawer for #255, but longer-term that kind of surface should live as a proper Drawer / shared layout once we are on Expo Router. **Do not block #266 on this work.**

Note: Expo Router is built on React Navigation under the hood. The goal is to stop owning our own stack/config wiring and adopt Expo Router’s file-based layouts (including Drawer where appropriate), not to remove React Navigation packages entirely if Expo Router still needs them as peers.

## Current vs expected

**Current**
- Entry via `index.js` / `App.tsx` → `AppNavigator` with conditional auth stacks
- Imperative `navigation.navigate(...)` typed against `RootStackParamList`
- Overlays like `UserSettingsMenu` implemented as Modal + custom gestures rather than navigation layouts

**Expected**
- Expo Router file-based routes / layouts as the app navigation source of truth
- Auth vs authenticated groups expressed as route groups / protected layouts
- Settings / account panel reconsidered as a Drawer (or equivalent layout) rather than another hand-rolled overlay when we touch that UI again
- Docs / agent onboarding updated for the new navigation model

## Scope

### In scope
- Adopt `expo-router` as the primary navigation layer (Android-only app; no iOS work)
- Replace `src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx` with Expo Router layouts/routes
- Migrate existing screens and typed params to the new routing model
- Preserve current auth gate, post-login sync, and screen behaviors
- Update architecture / onboarding docs that describe navigation
- Revisit settings slide-out (`UserSettingsMenu`) as a Drawer / layout once Router is in place (can be same PR or a thin follow-up if splitting is cleaner)

### Out of scope
- Redesigning screen UX beyond what’s required for the migration
- iOS / Expo Go–only workflows
- Blocking or reworking #266 / #255 solely for this migration

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] App boots and navigates via Expo Router (file-based routes/layouts), not a custom `createStackNavigator` `AppNavigator`
- [ ] Auth and authenticated flows remain gated correctly (login / forgot password / legal vs home / settings / sync / drafting, etc.)
- [ ] Existing primary user journeys work on Android: sign-in, home tabs, project chapters, drafting, settings, sync, prepare-for-offline, account switch / add user, sign-out
- [ ] Typed route params cover the previous `RootStackParamList` cases (or an equivalent typed Expo Router param map)
- [ ] Settings / accounts entry uses a Router-friendly pattern (prefer Drawer / shared layout over a one-off Modal drawer) unless a ticket-level waiver documents why not
- [ ] Agent/docs that describe navigation (`docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`, architecture notes) reflect Expo Router
- [ ] CI gates pass (`format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `npm test -- --ci`); Android device QA recorded for critical navigation paths before ready-for-review

## Verification / test plan

1. Fresh install / login → land on Home
2. Open settings entry → navigate More Settings / Privacy / Terms / Add User / switch account / Sign Out
3. Open a project → chapter → verse drafting → back stack behaves correctly
4. Sync and Prepare for Offline still reachable and return correctly
5. Cold start with restored session still reaches authenticated Home
6. Run CI command order from `.cursor/rules/commands.mdc`

## File pointers & approach

| Area | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Current navigator | `src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx` |
| Param types | `src/types/navigation/types.ts` |
| App shell | `App.tsx`, `index.js` |
| Screens | `src/app/screens/*`, `src/app/tabs/*` |
| Settings drawer (near-term custom) | `src/components/ui/UserSettingsMenu.tsx` |
| App config / entry | `app.config.ts`, `package.json` `main` |

**Suggested approach**
1. Spike Expo Router entry (`expo-router/entry`) + `app/` route layout skeleton against current stack map
2. Move auth vs authenticated groups into route groups / protected layouts
3. Port screens one cluster at a time (auth → home shell → project/drafting → settings/legal)
4. Replace imperative navigate call sites; keep behavior parity
5. Replace or wrap settings overlay with Drawer layout once Router is live
6. Update docs; remove obsolete `AppNavigator` wiring

## Links

- Related PR (non-blocking context): https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/266
- Related issue (settings panel UX): https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/issues/255
- Expo Router docs: https://docs.expo.dev/router/introduction/
- Board: [Fluent Mobile Board](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9)
